'''2019 North American Continental Championship''' (John Anderson Memorial) was the Players Committee North American Continental Championship, held 23–25 August 2019 in Bloomington, Minnesota, in memory of [[John Anderson]].<ref name="ja-announce">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=1245707#p1245707 Announcing the John Anderson Memorial Continental Tournament], Players Committee forum (imrahil327, 28 February 2019). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125051458/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/p1245707.html Internet Archive]</ref> [[Greg Shaw]] finished 1st in Day 2.<ref name="pc">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/2019-north-american-continentals/ starwarsccg.org], starwarsccg.org. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261013160247/https://swccg.com/snapshots/pc/2019-north-american-continentals.html Internet Archive].</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Open]]
* '''Site:''' Hyatt Regency, Bloomington, Minnesota<ref name="ja-hotel">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=1245708#p1245708 Hotel Information], Players Committee forum (imrahil327, 28 February 2019). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125051959/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/p1245708.html Internet Archive]</ref>
* '''Dates:''' 23–25 August 2019<ref name="ja-sched">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=1259062#p1259062 Event Schedule details], Players Committee forum (gogolen, 8 June 2019). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125052008/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/p1259062.html Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="ja-twins">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=1254753#p1254753 Tigers @ Twins, 8/23 (Group Outing Friday)], Players Committee forum (imrahil327, 3 May 2019).</ref>

== John Anderson Memorial ==

The Players Committee dedicated the event to [[John Anderson]], a Minnesota and North Dakota player and volunteer who died in 2018, holding it in Minnesota near his friends and family.<ref name="ja-announce" /> On Friday 23 August, in place of a team tournament, players went to the Minnesota Twins vs. Detroit Tigers game at Target Field, where a donor found by [[Garrett Larson]] put a message dedicated to John on the scoreboard.<ref name="ja-twins" /><ref name="ja-official">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=1272925#p1272925 Tigers @ Twins, 8/23 (Group Outing Friday): official scoreboard picture], Players Committee forum (imrahil327, 17 September 2019). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125053125/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/p1272925.html Internet Archive]</ref> Every participant received a John Anderson Continentals pin and lanyard.<ref name="ja-prereg">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=1259061#p1259061 Pre-registration Now Available], Players Committee forum (gogolen, 8 June 2019). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125052108/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/p1259061.html Internet Archive]</ref> Booster packs at the event each held a card from John's collection with a gold foil "P71" memorial stamp, plus the new Virtual cards [[Captain Khurgee (V)|•Captain Khurgee (V)]], [[Puck|•Puck]] and [[Red 12|•Red&nbsp;12]].<ref name="ja-cards">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=1270423#p1270423 Release of 3 Premium Virtual Cards at the John Anderson Memorial Tournament], Players Committee forum (DesignAdvocate, 27 August 2019). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125052249/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/p1270423.html Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="ja-stamp">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=1270397#p1270397 Willing to trade for/buy John Anderson stamped Overseer: the stamp], Players Committee forum (Shadow 14, 27 August 2019). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125052311/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/p1270397.html Internet Archive]</ref> Members of John's family attended the opening.<ref name="ja-family">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=1271192#p1271192 Announcing the John Anderson Memorial Continental Tournament (message from the Anderson family)], Players Committee forum (gogolen, 30 August 2019). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125051458/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/p1245707.html Internet Archive]</ref>
